columns.name: MATERIAL
columns.expr: weighted({'Plastic': 30, 'Paper and Card': 31, 'Glass': 12 if r['SECTOR'] in ('Food & Drink','Hospitality','Grocery Retail') else 3, 'Aluminium': 6 if r['SECTOR'] in ('Food & Drink','Grocery Retail','Health & Beauty') else 2, 'Steel': 4, 'Wood': 3 if r['SECTOR'] in ('Industrial & B2B','Electricals') else 1, 'Fibre-based Composite': 5 if r['SECTOR'] in ('Food & Drink','Grocery Retail','Hospitality') else 1, 'Other': 1})

columns.name: PACKAGING_TYPE
columns.expr: weighted({'Household': 62, 'Non-household': 26, 'Public Bin': 5, 'Household Drinks Container': 7 if r['PACKAGING_FORMAT'] in ('Bottle','Can') else 0}) if r['SECTOR'] != 'Industrial & B2B' else weighted({'Non-household': 85, 'Household': 15})

columns.name: PACKAGING_CLASS
columns.expr: 'Shipment Packaging' if r['PACKAGING_FORMAT'] in ('Pallet','Crate') else weighted({'Primary Packaging': 64, 'Secondary Packaging': 22, 'Shipment Packaging': 14}) if r['MATERIAL'] == 'Paper and Card' else weighted({'Primary Packaging': 86, 'Secondary Packaging': 10, 'Shipment Packaging': 4})

columns.name: RAM_RATING
columns.expr: weighted({'Red': (52 if r['PACKAGING_FORMAT'] in ('Flexible Film','Pouch','Pump and Trigger','Composite Tube','Coffee Cup','Mixed Material','Ceramic') else 14 if r['MATERIAL'] in ('Plastic','Fibre-based Composite') else 4) * ((1 - 0.72 * ramp(300)) if r['SECTOR'] == 'Health & Beauty' else 1), 'Amber': 26 if r['MATERIAL'] in ('Plastic','Fibre-based Composite','Other') else 8, 'Green': (22 if r['MATERIAL'] in ('Plastic','Fibre-based Composite','Other') else 88) * ((1 + 1.4 * ramp(300)) if r['SECTOR'] == 'Health & Beauty' else 1)})

columns.name: RECYCLED_CONTENT_PCT
columns.expr: round(min(95.0, max(0.0, {'Plastic': 22, 'Paper and Card': 64, 'Glass': 38, 'Aluminium': 48, 'Steel': 40, 'Wood': 20, 'Fibre-based Composite': 8, 'Other': 5}[r['MATERIAL']] * (1 + 0.25 * ramp(365)) * uniform(0.55, 1.45))), 1)

columns.name: UNITS_PLACED
columns.expr: int(lognorm({'Plastic': 42000, 'Paper and Card': 15000, 'Glass': 9000, 'Aluminium': 30000, 'Steel': 12000, 'Wood': 160, 'Fibre-based Composite': 26000, 'Other': 3000}[r['MATERIAL']] * (0.35 if r['PRODUCER_SIZE'] == 'Small Producer' else 1), 0.8))

columns.name: WEIGHT_TONNES
columns.expr: round(r['UNITS_PLACED'] * {'Bottle': 28 if r['MATERIAL'] == 'Plastic' else 310, 'Tray': 18, 'Flexible Film': 4, 'Pouch': 6, 'Pot and Tub': 14, 'Closure': 2.5, 'Pump and Trigger': 22, 'Corrugated Box': 280, 'Folding Carton': 32, 'Paper Bag': 45, 'Label and Sleeve': 1.5, 'Jar': 220, 'Can': 14 if r['MATERIAL'] == 'Aluminium' else 52, 'Foil and Tray': 9, 'Aerosol': 38 if r['MATERIAL'] == 'Aluminium' else 62, 'Pallet': 22000, 'Crate': 4500, 'Beverage Carton': 27, 'Coffee Cup': 11, 'Composite Tube': 24, 'Mixed Material': 40, 'Ceramic': 180}[r['PACKAGING_FORMAT']] * uniform(0.85, 1.15) / 1000000.0, 3)

columns.name: BASE_FEE_PER_TONNE_GBP
columns.expr: ({'Plastic': 423, 'Paper and Card': 196, 'Glass': 192, 'Aluminium': 266, 'Steel': 259, 'Wood': 280, 'Fibre-based Composite': 461, 'Other': 259}[r['MATERIAL']] * (1.0 if d.year < 2026 or (d.year == 2026 and d.month < 4) else 1.07)) if r['PACKAGING_TYPE'] in ('Household', 'Public Bin') else 0.0

columns.name: PRN_PRICE_PER_TONNE_GBP
columns.expr: round({'Plastic': 88 * (1 + 1.75 * ramp(210)), 'Paper and Card': 24, 'Glass': 52, 'Aluminium': 46, 'Steel': 34, 'Wood': 14, 'Fibre-based Composite': 24, 'Other': 30}[r['MATERIAL']] * uniform(0.92, 1.08), 2)

columns.name: VALIDATION_CHECKS_FAILED
columns.expr: weighted({0: 90, 1: 6, 2: 2.5, 3: 1.5}) if r['PRODUCER_SIZE'] == 'Large Producer' else weighted({0: 82, 1: 10, 2: 5, 3: 3})

columns.name: ISSUE_TYPE
columns.expr: 'None' if r['VALIDATION_CHECKS_FAILED'] == 0 else weighted({'Missing Weight': 22, 'Unit Weight Outlier': 20, 'Material Not Classified': 14, 'Nation of Sale Missing': 12, 'Packaging Type Mismatch': 14, 'Supplier Data Not Received': 18})

post.name: ISSUE_STATUS
post.expr: 'No Issue' if r['ISSUE_TYPE'] == 'None' else ('Open' if r['SUBMISSION_STATUS'] in ('Data Collection', 'In Validation', 'Resubmission Required') else 'Resolved')
